## User task or missing design capability

Who benefits and what should become possible or clearer?

## Proposed approach

Explain the layout, information architecture, interaction or tool behavior. A palette swap alone is not a new design grammar.

## Reference evidence

Link primary sources or actual examples. Distinguish visual inspiration from usability evidence; include licenses if proposing third-party assets.

## How to verify

Describe a realistic success path, a failure/recovery path, keyboard and mobile behavior, and any regression tests.

## Tradeoffs

What complexity, performance cost or compatibility risk does this add? What simpler alternative did you consider?
